decision: Do not promote the 28 nm Gaussian and do not infer W_emit from MDC output.

cp_and_lp_ranges.reason: 400-500 nm CP coverage and LP evaluation windows are numerical coverage, not measured emission spectrum.

historical_28nm_gaussian.normalization: Relative normalization by integral/trapezoid over the sampled grid; 440-460 capture fraction uses erf(10/(sqrt(2)*sigma)).
historical_28nm_gaussian.support: Mathematically Gaussian; MDC comparison sampled 420-480 nm at 301 points.
historical_28nm_gaussian.weight_domain: Power-domain source weighting in the MDC comparison postprocessor; weighted metrics divide by integral of w on the available grid.

mdc_output.reason: r12_normalized_output is conditioned MDC output, not bare MicroLED emission; cannot be promoted to W_emit.

mqw_weights.reason: Equal 12-well weights define source-position ensemble, not spectral envelope.

required_future_authority: Measured or otherwise physical bare MicroLED emitted-power spectrum
normalization convention on the integrated wavelength grid
